name: oci-oidc-auth-config
description: Keyless OCI auth via OIDC for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && ncc build build/github-action.js -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt && ncc build build/cli.js -o dist-cli --source-map --license licenses-cli.txt && node scripts/copy-cli-dist.mjs && rm -rf build
